selinux_mode.description: SELinux enforcement mode. 'enforcing' blocks policy violations, 'permissive' logs but does not block, 'disabled' turns off SELinux entirely.

selinux_policy_type.description: The SELinux policy type to apply. 'targeted' protects specific network daemons; 'minimum' is a stripped-down targeted policy; 'mls' provides Multi-Level Security for high-assurance environments.

unconfined_policy.description: Enable 'unconfined' domains: allows processes to run without strict labeling (e.g., 'unconfined_t'). Recommended only for troubleshooting or containers with confined alternatives.
